mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (below 4.5% historical average) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (exceeding 0.3 percentage points over three months) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE rise > 0.3pp in 3 months).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and retail sales (both rising by at least 0.5% month-over-month) signals strong consumer demand, boosting corporate revenue growth and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS increase by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of high industrial production growth (INDPRO above 105), robust economic activity supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when INDPRO is above 105, SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of industrial production (INDPRO above 105) indicates robust economic activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is above 105.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp acceleration in CPI (exceeding 0.5 percentage points over three months) signals rising inflation, which may trigger monetary policy tightening and reduce equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in federal funds rate and CPI (both rising by at least 0.25 percentage points month-over-month) indicates monetary tightening amid inflation, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL increase by at least 0.25pp month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of strong GDP growth (GDPC1 growth rate above 2.5% annualized), robust economic expansion supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when GDPC1 growth rate is above 2.5% annualized, SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.
